summary: The map is strongest when provider evidence, model behavior and runtime capabilities are evaluated separately and then joined at dispatch.

items.text: Combine the provider decision with a separately maintained record of model capability, behavioral evaluations and task fit.
Translate allowed cells into enforceable network, filesystem, secret and tool capabilities at runtime.
Route high-risk combinations into a hardened execution environment even when the provider and model are otherwise approved.
Expose the resulting route and evidence as one layer in a broader, inspectable trust decision.
